events.what: Burungale, Skinner, Tian and Wan prove the supersingular p-part of BSD for analytic rank 0 or 1, giving the first infinite families of quadratic twists of non-CM curves over Q satisfying full strong BSD
Banwait and Huang identify 36,687 LMFDB curves of conductor at most 500,000 admitting such infinite twist families
Self-published full-proof claims (Zenodo/Shimizu, SSRN 'Relational Field Theory', preprints.org 'Iran Formula')
events.credibility_reason: Self-published solo claims of a Millennium Problem, no expert uptake, grandiose framing; mainstream follow-up (Banwait-Huang 2026) treats BSD as open in general and does not cite them.

judgement.doubts: The earlier hand correction (claimed -> partial) is right: F1 case. BSTW remains undigested per the record, which does not affect a partial tier. Two crank claims were not opened; they are set aside on the record's description, not on a full read.
